interface.shortDescription: Run CCG with automatic Grok intelligence and manual GPT Pro evidence
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native CCG fork where Codex owns planning, implementation, and verification. The official Grok Build CLI provides opt-in, source-backed Web/X external intelligence through an isolated ACP profile, Gemini and Claude provide bounded evidence, and GPT Pro remains a manual high-value reviewer. Includes hardened snapshots, canonical evidence, Git/context helpers, spec and team workflows, and local quality/security gates.
